title: Swakopmund to Uis and back, by private vehicle
subtitle: A fixed price for the whole car, agreed before you commit. A round trip prices differently depending on whether the car waits for you — so here are the three shapes.
vehicle: Private — the whole car is yours

options.title: Same-day return — the car waits for you
options.note: Out in the morning, back the same evening. About 6h 10m of driving across the day, so it is a long one, but it works. The driver and vehicle stay with you at Uis throughout.

options.title: The car and driver stay over with you
options.note: For an overnight or longer at Uis. The vehicle is yours for the whole period, not just the two drives. Each extra night covers the driver’s day and their bed.

options.title: Two separate one-way transfers
options.note: Right only if the dates are far apart and the car should not wait: our published one-way fares, N$3,500 out and N$2,800 back. A car sent to Uis usually drives home empty.

next_title: To go ahead, or to pin it down
next_body: Tell us the travel date and how many of you are going, and we will confirm the vehicle and issue a booking reference (NT-XXXXXX) with a link holding the trip, the fare and how to pay. Nothing is charged at that point.
